The White House is (truly) winning the oil jawboning battle against Tehran — still to be seen if Trump would win the physical oil market war. 

But to see Brent trading at sub-$100 a barrel (and WTI below $90) after 25 days of Hormuz almost full closure is almost surreal.

India has bought ~60 million barrels of Russian oil in March, and already booked a similar amount for delivery in April. 

The purchases are at a premium of $5-$15 a barrel **above** the Brent benchmark. And current prices, that’s worth >$6.5 billion for each month. 

Putin wins.
